instruction: Generate a new sheet and compile a summary table listing total revenue per product.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new sheet with a summary table of total revenue per product. Verified with Python script: 11 products with revenues calculated from all 29 data rows. Expected values computed by summing revenue for each product: Quad=707.82, Aspen=479.13, Carlota=298.05, Doublers=240.99, Sunbell=200.15, Sunset=143.89, Sunshine=142.05, Crested Beaut=75.62, FlatTop=28.92, Majectic Beaut=28.28, Bellen=23.25. Custom getter extracts product-revenue pairs from Sheet2, metric validates all products and revenues match (with 0.5 tolerance for floating point).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Score is based on the proportion of products with correct total revenue values (11 products total, each contributing 1/11 to final score)

llm_judge_reasons: Correct parameter handling: Metric properly accesses expected.get('products') where expected IS the rules dictionary returned by get_rule
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all 11 products and their total revenues as required by the instruction
Proper getter logic: Extracts product-revenue table from Sheet2 (new sheet) with appropriate error handling for missing sheets and type conversion
Appropriate metric logic: Uses tolerance (0.5) for floating-point comparison, calculates partial credit score correctly
Adequate postconfig: Saves file (Ctrl+S) before verification to ensure data is persisted
Expected values verified: Metadata shows revenues calculated from actual data (29 rows, 11 products with correct sums)
Edge case handling: Getter handles missing sheets, empty rows, and type conversion errors appropriately
